slices.focus: Second corridor winter rollout fails due to operator shortages; Nathaniel faces ugly first-month numbers in a tense leadership review.
slices.summary: The winter rollout of Nathaniel's second corridor collapses when operator shortages force emergency block swaps and ad hoc coverage. He presents ugly first-month metrics (missed trips up, complaints up) in a tense meeting, feeling the credibility he built with the first corridor erode. He shifts to daily rechecking of assumptions.
